reason: Kra pao and kai jeow are the first things I learned from TikTok clips, and 3 free questions a day is already more than I'd use for two easy dishes. Maybe I'd download the free app to try it, but I won't pay 99 baht a month for questions I don't need.
objection: Only two dishes, and both are free all over YouTube and TikTok, so unlimited questions mean nothing to me. My kitchen is tiny and I only have one pan, so I'm not sure an app helps me more than a one-minute clip.
would_change_my_mind: Lots more dishes made for one pan in a tiny kitchen, so I'd cook with it most nights and actually run out of the free questions.
